findings.label: Synchronous insets read on AVAILABLE open
findings.detail: openImeKeyboard(probing=false) reads imeOccludedTop() right after showSoftInput, before ime() insets apply, so the first scroll-into-view is skipped. Self-corrects via the session-lifetime insets listener. No action required. Unchanged from prior pass, not in this commit's scope.

findings.label: Probe-in-flight blank window up to 700ms
findings.detail: During the lazy probe imeSession is non-null and onKeyboardChanged(true) has fired while nothing is drawn. Back/toggle route to closeImeKeyboard and a resolved-UNAVAILABLE rebuilds the canvas keyboard. Acceptable. No action required.

findings.label: Whitespace-only ADDRESS Go parity nuance
findings.detail: routeImeEdit ADDRESS Go uses isNotBlank() while canvas commitKeyboard guards on isEmpty(); both receive trimmed text upstream so the divergence is unreachable in practice. No action required.
